title: Workspace contamination
summary: A tracked change MUST be treated as clean when every blocking path is attributed to the active worker in the run workspace. Every other tracked change MUST be treated as contamination.
instructions: A tracked change is clean when every changed blocking path is explicitly traced to the active worker and lies in the run workspace. Worker-attributed edits MUST NOT fail `scope.no_unattributed_changes`.

instructions.text: The harness MUST inject `scope.no_unattributed_changes` for any stage whose `workspace_policy` is not `source_allowed`. `release_metadata_only` identifies expected self-development release paths. Coverage: `tests/regression/read-only-mutation.test.ts::read-only stage fails when a source workspace change is unattributed`.

instructions: A tracked change MUST be treated as contamination when it is external, mixed, unknown, or unattributed, or when it falls outside the clean rules above. A tracked change in the harness root MUST be treated as contamination when the run works in another directory. A failing result MUST name the paths that caused it.
